note: These assignments repair inherited province centroids that are displaced outside their named region or combine island groups too coarsely for direct point-in-polygon ownership. They are gameplay projections, not new historical boundary evidence.

overrides.notes: Araucania inherits a polar centroid and is projected to Chile.
Cape Colony inherits a polar centroid and is projected to the Union of South Africa.
The inherited Indian Ocean grouping lacks a usable island centroid and is projected to British Mauritius.
Patagonia Meridional inherits a polar centroid and is projected to Argentina.
The South Atlantic island grouping has no single reviewed dependency polygon at this resolution and is projected to the United Kingdom.
Western Polynesia combines several islands and inherits a polar centroid; it is projected to the British Western Pacific Territories.
The Scottish Highlands centroid is displaced into the North Atlantic and is projected to the United Kingdom.
The inherited Iceland and Greenland province has one centroid in Greenland; it is projected to Denmark because Iceland is separately represented and independent on the scenario date.
Fiji has a displaced inherited centroid and is projected to the Colony of Fiji.
Nordnorge has an offshore high-latitude centroid and is projected to Norway.
Macaronesia combines multiple archipelagos and is projected to Portugal for the coarse province mesh.
